categories.main_business_segments: Electronic Arts (EA) operates as a single reportable segment focused on digital interactive entertainment. Its primary business lines include the development, marketing, publishing, and delivery of games, content, and services for consoles, PCs, and mobile devices. EA's portfolio features wholly owned brands (such as Apex Legends, Battlefield, and The Sims) and licensed franchises (such as Madden NFL, Star Wars, and its global football ecosystem).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: EA leverages proprietary and licensed technologies to develop games across multiple platforms, utilizing both in-house and external development teams. The company emphasizes live services, digital distribution, and scalable online infrastructure to support ongoing content delivery, multiplayer experiences, and community engagement. EA invests in R&D for game engines, online hosting, and creation tools, and integrates technologies acquired through M&A (e.g., Glu Mobile, Playdemic).
categories.primary_customers_markets: EA serves a global base of individual consumers, primarily targeting gamers on consoles, PCs, and mobile devices. Key customer segments include sports fans, action and shooter game enthusiasts, simulation players, and mobile gamers. Major end markets are the entertainment and digital gaming industries, with significant revenue from annualized sports franchises and live service offerings.
categories.geographic_coverage: EA operates globally, with significant revenue generated in North America and internationally (notably Europe and Asia). In fiscal 2022, 57% of net revenue was international. The company has key partnerships and distribution agreements in regions such as China and Korea, and maintains development and publishing operations worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: EA is positioned downstream in the supply chain as a publisher and distributor of finished digital entertainment products and services. It manages the full lifecycle from game development to direct and third-party digital/retail distribution, and partners with platform owners (Sony, Microsoft, Apple, Google) for access to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: EA's strategic priorities include expanding live services, growing its mobile business, investing in new IP and franchises, and enhancing player engagement through innovation and social connectivity. R&D efforts focus on live service models, cross-platform play, community creation tools, and leveraging acquisitions to accelerate mobile and sports leadership. The company also emphasizes inclusion, diversity, and positive play initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: EA generates revenue through a mix of digital and physical full game sales, live services (including extra content, in-game purchases, and subscriptions), and licensing. Live services, especially extra content for Ultimate Team and Apex Legends, account for the majority of revenue. Subscription offerings (EA Play) and free-to-play models with monetized content are also significant contributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EA faces intense competition from major interactive entertainment companies such as Activision Blizzard, Take-Two Interactive, Ubisoft, Epic Games, Tencent, NetEase, and platform owners like Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo. It also competes with large technology firms (Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Netflix) entering gaming. EA is a market leader in sports and live service games, with strong brand recognition and a broad portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year ended March 31, 2022, EA reported $6.99 billion in net revenue (up 24% year-over-year), $789 million in net income, and $1.9 billion in operating cash flow. Live services contributed 71% of total net revenue. The company has demonstrated consistent growth, driven by digital adoption, live services expansion, and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EA differentiates itself through a diverse portfolio of leading franchises, robust live service offerings, and the ability to engage players across multiple platforms and business models. Its focus on innovation, community engagement, and ongoing content updates provides recurring value to players. EA emphasizes safe, inclusive, and positive play environments, and leverages its scale and technology to deliver high-quality, socially connected entertainment experiences.
